reviews.text: An excellent place to leave our pets with complete confidence! Roberto's service was always exceptional and clear. 10000% recommended! My dog ​​was happy!
Excellent service from the moment my pet was dropped off until the moment he was picked up. He was returned to me happy and clean. I will gladly use their services again. Thank you so much.
Hi Kenia, Nice to meet you Roberto. I don't have any record of a visit with us under your name or surname. I would greatly appreciate more information about your visit or your pet. ☺️

We love Happy Pups 💕 We've left my dog ​​with Roberto countless times and we always feel completely at ease. We know she's well cared for and happy there.
Thank you, Roberto!

Roberto's service was excellent from the moment I asked for information. The way he spoke about the dogs with such affection convinced me that I didn't want any other hotel but Roberto's. My dog, Phoebe, arrived home clean, fed, and happy. I received messages and videos of my baby—everything I needed. I would leave Phoebe there again without hesitation!

Excellent service and attention from Roberto and Mrs. Magda! I use their daycare/hotel service for my pit bulls every time I travel, and everything is great!

I wouldn't go anywhere else!

I want to share my experience leaving my two furry friends at this dog hotel. From the very first moment, the staff member was fantastic, showing great patience and professionalism. He had had a similar situation with them and even offered advice.

When I picked them up, they were both happy, calm, and freshly bathed. Personally, I felt incredibly reassured by the way they were treated.

A fantastic experience! I have three dogs: two large and one small. Roberto was incredibly patient with all of them! And my furry friends came back so happy! Thank you so much, Happy Pups, for taking such good care of my little beasts!
A very nice place, where my Sunny felt very comfortable. I saw her very happy and cheerful, freshly bathed and smelling wonderful. Truly excellent service! 🐶🐶🐶😊😊 …
